howToSwap: Set a slot's `swap`, then run `remake apply`. Text and attributes: the new words. Images: a path to your file. Videos: a path to an MP4, or to a photo (it becomes a slow-zoom clip). Fonts: a Google Fonts family name (e.g. "Inter"). Links: the new URL. Forms: the address that should receive submissions. Colours: any CSS colour. Inline SVG logos: a path to your .svg. Leave `swap` null to keep the original.
